name: PM-KISAN Grievance API Attributes
privacy_notes: applicantId carries the farmer's PM-KISAN registration number, which is both the identity the portal authenticates on and the enrolment the complaint is against; on support it is Support.orderId. It is no-log and no-trace without exception, and never appears in an error body. It is deliberately not no-echo: on_support returns it in orderId to the caller who sent it. A case read does not return it -- a Contract has no orderId, and it is not surfaced as an attribute either.

The upstream status record also returns the farmer's name, father's name, gender, mobile number and full address. None of it is modelled or emitted; an adapter must drop these fields rather than pass them through commitmentAttributes.
grievanceDescription is free text written by a farmer and may contain personal details the schema cannot constrain. It is returned verbatim on a case read.
The portal payload is carried inside an encrypted envelope. A decryption failure must not log the ciphertext.
